desc: Establish and document the component characterization of f(L,R) and the identity components = distinct count - adjacent-present pairs.
Implement last-occurrence aggregate sweep: maintain sum of last occurrences and sum of adjacent last-occurrence minima while scanning R, adding their difference to the answer.
Validate the identity and sweep on small brute-force examples and the provided samples.
Handle boundary cases: N=1, values 1 and N, all equal values, all distinct values, and repeated occurrences.
Ensure O(N) time and memory, fast I/O, and Python big-integer accumulation.
